Department_Program: Bogen International Graduate Program, Department of Economics (direct PhD track)
Fit_Notes: Local pilot access; development economics plus finance. The Bogen programme is the English-taught direct-PhD route: two years of coursework then three of research. Business School PhD is a separate route at https://bschool-en.huji.ac.il/phd - relevant if the thesis leans finance rather than development.

Department_Program: Coller School of Management - Doctoral Program
Fit_Notes: Sustainability + finance interdisciplinary. Admissions favour graduates of their own MSc, but explicitly consider holders of a thesis master's in an allied discipline - which is the route that would apply here.

Department_Program: Department of Public Policy and Management / Economics
Fit_Notes: Development and behavioral economics. URL is the department research portal - useful for identifying supervisors by publication. The admissions page on in.bgu.ac.il could not be reached from the build environment, so it is deliberately not recorded here rather than guessed.

Department_Program: Smith School / Oxford Sustainable Finance Group (DPhil)
Fit_Notes: World-leading sustainable finance, strong DFI links. Important structural detail: there is no standalone Smith School DPhil - applications go through the School of Geography and the Environment DPhil, with OSFG supervising or co-supervising. They take very few students a year and aim to fund at least one.

Deep risk + development finance expertise. Structured as a two-year MRes then PhD; first year is shared with the Economics PhD cohort, so the econometrics grounding is strong. Note it is a full-time research track - check whether it can accommodate ongoing venture work.

Department_Program: Judge Business School - PhD & research masters
Fit_Notes: Quant finance + sustainability practitioner network. Entry is via a 9-month research master's then 3-4 years PhD, joining one of 8 pathways - the pathway choice matters more than the school for supervisor fit. CISL is a separate centre at https://www.cisl.cam.ac.uk/

Department_Program: PhD in Finance with the Swiss Finance Institute (GFRI)
Fit_Notes: Highly quantitative, sustainable finance research. Run across the three SFI campuses; one preparatory year of coursework then three of research. GFRI lists sustainable finance among its active doctoral topics.

University: IESEG School of Management / University of Lille
Department_Program: PhD programme with the University of Lille (SESAM doctoral school)
Fit_Notes: Applied focus, may allow more fieldwork flexibility. The Lille route runs 3-5 years. IESEG also runs a joint doctoral programme in Business Economics with KU Leuven at https://www.ieseg.fr/en/programs/phd-programs/joint-ieseg-kuleuven-doctoral-program-business-economics/ - worth comparing before applying.

Department_Program: Sustainable Development, Economic Growth and Finance (PhD opportunity)
Fit_Notes: Financial systems + inclusive growth focus. This is a named PhD opportunity rather than a generic programme, and its stated scope - how financial systems, markets and policy frameworks drive sustainable and inclusive growth - is the closest direct match to this project's research question of any programme on the list.
